cf-controller.description: Cloud Foundry v3 Cloud Controller API (mock). Inspect and operate apps deployed in the CF runtime: list/inspect apps, check CPU/memory stats and logs/events, and start/stop/restart/scale/deploy (stateful in local mock).

recent_logs.message: WARN event-loop lag 210ms; heap 78% of limit
ERROR upstream timeout to entitlements-svc after 5000ms

getCfOrganizations.description: List Cloud Foundry organizations in the global account.

getCfSpaces.description: List Cloud Foundry spaces, optionally filtered by organization.

organizationGuid.description: Filter spaces by this CF organization GUID.

getCfApps.description: List Cloud Foundry apps in a space (or all apps). Returns app GUID, name, state (STARTED/STOPPED), instance count, memory/disk, and current version. Use this first to resolve an app name to its GUID before calling other CF tools.

spaceGuid.description: Filter apps by this CF space GUID.

name.description: Filter apps by exact app name.

getCfApp.description: Get one Cloud Foundry app's details by GUID or name.

name.description: The CF app name (alternative to appGuid).

getCfAppProcesses.description: List the processes (e.g. 'web', 'worker') of a CF app with their instance count and memory/disk allocation.

getCfAppProcessStats.description: Get per-instance runtime stats for a CF app process: CPU %, memory and disk usage, instance state, and uptime. Use to check whether an app is under CPU/memory pressure.

getCfAppRecentLogs.description: Fetch recent log lines for a CF app (Log Cache). Returns envelopes with timestamp, source, and message. Use to diagnose errors/warnings.

limit.description: Max number of recent log lines to return.

getCfAppEvents.description: List recent audit events for a CF app (deploys, updates, restarts, scales).

startCfApp.description: Start a CF app (sets desired state STARTED). Lifecycle write - confirm first.

stopCfApp.description: Stop a CF app (sets desired state STOPPED). Lifecycle write - confirm first.

restartCfApp.description: Restart a CF app (rolling). Lifecycle write - confirm first.

scaleCfAppProcess.description: Scale a CF app process: change instance count and/or per-instance memory/disk. Write - confirm first. Stats reflect the new instance count afterward.

createCfAppDeployment.description: Create a metadata-only rolling deployment for a CF app (bumps the app's current version and marks it STARTED). Write - confirm first.

version.description: The new version label to deploy (e.g. v2.8.2).
